lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

Lawyers for the alleged co-conspirator in the mass shooting in Tumbler Ridge, B.C., argue for a release form detention, here is the alleged timeline set out in court documents, The Canadian Press reports.
Drops for Nvidia, Anthropic and other AI stocks drag the U.S. market back down, The Associated Press reports.
A federal grand jury indicts Thomas Markle on child sex abuse material charges, The Associated Press reports.

A U.S. jury convicted Chinese tech giant Huawei Technologies on Tuesday of conspiracy to steal trade secrets and bank fraud as it grew into one of the world’s biggest suppliers of gear for wireless telecommunications networks, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
